rae-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：一条跑道斜穿阿拉尔郊外的干旱平原，机坪与航站楼在跑道一侧。
rae-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: a runway cuts across arid plain outside Arar, with the apron and terminal alongside it.

rae-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 弧形玻璃幕墙的航站楼外，登机口标牌用阿拉伯文和英文写着三号门。
rae-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Outside a terminal with a curved glass wall, a sign marks Gate 3 in Arabic and English.

rae-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 宽敞明亮的候机大厅里，旅客拖着行李走过，头顶的深蓝指示牌写着出发。
rae-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Travellers pull their luggage across a bright, wide concourse beneath dark blue signs pointing to departures.

rae-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架沙特航空的宽体客机停在宽阔的混凝土机坪上，晴朗的蓝天没有一丝云。
rae-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A Saudia wide-body jet stands on a broad concrete apron under a cloudless blue sky.

rae-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 夜里，旅客拉着行李箱走向亮着灯的出发入口，光滑的石板地面映出灯光。
rae-chatgpt-04.webp.en: At night, travellers wheel their cases toward the lit departures entrance, the polished floor reflecting the glow.

rae-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 到达大厅空旷安静，蓝白色调的租车柜台前拉起隔离带，地面反着灯光。
rae-chatgpt-05.webp.en: The arrivals hall stands quiet and empty, blue barriers set before car-rental desks while the polished floor mirrors the ceiling lights.

rae-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 黄昏的航拍里，跑道灯连成一条亮线，笔直伸向暮色中的荒漠。
rae-chatgpt-06.webp.en: In this dusk aerial view the runway edge lights form a bright line running straight out into the desert dark.
